title: Die älteste Kunst, insbesondere die Baukunst der Germanen von der Völkerwanderung bis zu Karl dem Grossen

This work explores the architectural heritage and artistic traditions of the Germanic peoples from the Migration Period through to the times of Charlemagne. It aims to reconstruct and acknowledge the artistic identity and achievements of the Germans, particularly in the context of a wider cultural heritage that often overshadowed their own contributions.
